screens.heading: Questions are brave
screens.body: Every great discoverer started with one small question. When you wonder "why?" or "how?" — that is curiosity waking up. You do not need all the answers today.

screens.heading: Mistakes teach you
screens.body: Your brain grows when something feels hard at first. A wrong guess is not failure — it is your mind trying a path. The cool part is what you learn next.

screens.heading: Yet means power
screens.body: Say "I cannot do it **yet**." That tiny word leaves the door open. Today you might stumble. Tomorrow you might surprise yourself. That is how skills are built.

screens.heading: Small steps count
screens.body: You do not climb a mountain in one jump. One page, one try, one kind question to a grown-up — each step moves you forward. Slow is still going.

screens.heading: Share what you notice
screens.body: Tell someone one thing you learned today. Speaking it out loud helps it stick. They might learn something from you too.

screens.heading: Keep wondering
screens.body: The world is full of puzzles waiting for curious people like you. Pick one thing to explore tomorrow. Your next question could be the start of something big.
